summary.text: Nine Spiritual Fairy arrives in the River of Time aboard Sun and Moon Temple as a Heavenly Court rank eight Gu Immortal among four rank eights reinforcing against Myriad Year Flying Warship.

claims.text: Two more time path Immortal Gu Houses join the field. Eternal Yacht carries Xing Ye Wang. She is on the other house. Heavenly Court’s time path Immortal Gu Houses reach six, and its morale soars.
She has a beautiful face. She likes to wear a long robe and wave her sleeves around, and she has a graceful aura. Her body is thin.

Heavenly Court gathers Moment Stage, Present and Past Pavilion, Three Autumn Yellow Crane Platform, Eternal Yacht, Shark Flow Lever, and Sun and Moon Temple, with Gu Liu Ru, Feng Jiu Ge, Xing Ye Wang, and Nine Spiritual Fairy, six Immortal Gu Houses and four rank eight Gu Immortals around Myriad Year Flying Warship. When Fang Yuan uses myriad year hunting, Gu Liu Ru sends Eternal Yacht and Shark Flow Lever out of the battlefield, and she jumps out of her Immortal Gu House, turning into an immemorial desolate beast to leave as well. After the new beast tide is lured toward the two houses, she intercepts the remaining twenty percent and takes control of them. Inside Myriad Year Flying Warship a Gu Immortal names her a rank eight great expert who cultivated enslavement path and transformation path in Central Continent’s history. Fang Yuan’s will notes that she did not wake in the previous life, but this time she woke, and even earlier. After she turns into an immemorial year beast, the River of Time is no longer an obstacle to her. When river suppression lotus sealing formation restricts myriad year hunting, she returns with the two houses and joins the encirclement. She is silent, but her movements are not slow: she gets around to the back of the warship, her aura bursts out, and she prepares a killer move.

After the stone lotus island ambush, she coughs blood in Central Great Hall and says that at the crucial moment Gu Liu Ru blocked Myriad Year Flying Warship while risking his life, and she managed to live because of him. She has a beautiful face, likes to wear a long robe and wave her sleeves around, and has a graceful aura, but now she is covered in blood, wounds are all over her body, her sleeves are cut and dangling, and her thin body looks fragile inside the large robe. In that River of Time battle Heavenly Court had the absolute advantage at the start, then lost completely. The six Immortal Gu Houses were destroyed. Only two Gu Immortals, Nine Spiritual Fairy and Feng Jiu Ge, managed to escape. Fairy Zi Wei calls her in to learn minor details of the fight. Even though the two are still alive, they did not bring back many Immortal Gu.

Spiritual light flashes as she appears before Red Heart Traveler. She was ordered to gather with him and go to Western Desert to find trouble with Fang clan. Qin Ding Ling inspects their luck: Nine Spiritual Fairy’s luck has nine spiritual lights, clear and clean, like leaves after withstanding a storm, bringing benefit to the world and giving off an aura of prosperity. Passing Embroidered Tower, she sighs that Feng Jiu Ge became despondent after the loss in the River of Time. Red Heart Traveler says he is comprehending his Dao. She is surprised and embarrassed: she inherited the nine spiritual transformations inheritance, cultivated it wholeheartedly, and did not modify it, so she was unaware of that state. He consoles her that her nine spiritual transformations is the greatest transformation path inheritance in Heavenly Court, already modified by countless generations of predecessors until it is near a perfection that cannot be modified further. She recalls that when her master gave her the true inheritance, he said her aptitude was insufficient. The two leave through Central Heaven Gate, enter white heaven, and go toward Western Desert.

In Western Desert she fights Qing Chou, a legendary immemorial desolate beast with intelligence comparable to a human’s, while Red Heart Traveler maintains a battlefield killer move. Qing Chou is not her. She has been paying attention to Red Heart Traveler’s condition and decides she can only use that move. She activates the immortal killer move nine spiritual transformations, returns to human form, and nine spiritual lights shoot from her immortal aperture to form an enormous nine-colored barrier of light with nine distinct layers. The completed move has no flaws. The mixed light becomes a rhinoceros with a large head and small body, shining with various colors, and it charges Qing Chou; Qing Chou takes a small step back while the rhino only stops. Red Heart Traveler names nine spiritual transformations a legendary transformation path killer move: after a Gu Immortal cultivates it, they can only use it nine times in their life, and she has chosen to expend one usage on Qing Chou. The light sphere then changes into a southern fire sparrow that collides onto Qing Chou’s back and engulfs it in blazing flames. She holds the battle tempo, but he judges she cannot last for long. After he seals Qing Chou with a blood sun insignia and blood threads, she suppresses the slowing beast and asks if he needs help. He says he could have the chance to use that unnamed sealing move because she did not hesitate to activate nine spiritual transformations. She answers that capturing Qing Chou concerns Heavenly Court’s plan, so she would not refuse to pay such a small price. They detain Qing Chou and move toward Central Continent.
